messages.subject: Stochastic Mapping error
parts:
Hi Nick

I get to the last part of the SM (runBSMslow) and then I get the following error:

Error in stochastic_map_branch(nodenum_at_top_of_branch = right_branch_decnode,  :
  object 'brlen_in_section' not found

Failure on stochastic mapping attempt #97/100 tries. Holding at success #0/50.
[1] "Error in stochastic_map_branch(nodenum_at_top_of_branch = right_branch_decnode,  : \n  object 'brlen_in_section' not found\n"
attr(,"class")
[1] "try-error"
attr(,"condition")
<simpleError in stochastic_map_branch(nodenum_at_top_of_branch = right_branch_decnode,     trtable = trtable, Qmat = Qmat, state_indices_0based = state_indices_0based,     ranges_list = ranges_list, areas = areas, stratified = stratified,     maxtries = maxtries): object 'brlen_in_section' not found>

Do you have any clue what could be hapening?

Thanks

Alejandro
